questionSnapshot.question: In The Aristocats, what is the name of the elegant mother cat?

notes: All four are cats from the family. Changed hard to medium for basic mother-name recall. #311 asks the children's names; #2493 asks Eva Gabor's cross-film casting, requiring an independent performer fact.

options.reason: Duchess is the pedigreed mother cat.
